title: Ukudla nokuthenga
description: Ten short, simple stories about food and shopping: buying goods, a child in a shop, a night bakery, a food factory, a sellers' meeting, bad water, a cooking class, a family custom, a new shop manager and a missing loaf.

lessons.title: Impahla kaNomvula
lessons.summary: Bheki buys ten things from Nomvula, a woman selling goods outside her house; his money is enough and the goods are light to carry home.
lessons.text:
UBheki ufuna ukuthenga ukudla. Uhamba ngendlela, bese ubona owesifazane. Owesifazane uhlala phansi ngaphandle kwendlu yakhe. Unempahla eningi: ukudla nezinye izinto zasekhaya.

UBheki uyambuza: "Ngubani igama lakho?"

Owesifazane uyaphendula: "Igama lami nguNomvula. Wena ungubani?"

UBheki uyaphendula: "NginguBheki. Ngifuna ukuthenga impahla yakho."

UNomvula uthi: "Kuhle! Ufunani?"

UBheki ubheka impahla yonke. Uthi: "Ngifuna ishumi lezinto. Ngizokhokha kanjani?"

"Ukukhokha kulula," kusho uNomvula. "Unganginika imali nje."

UBheki uthatha izinto. Uyazibala. Ziyishumi. Bese uyabuza: "Imali yami iyalingana na?"

UNomvula uyayibala imali kaBheki. Uyaphendula: "Kunjalo, iyalingana."

UBheki uyakhokha. Bese uNomvula uyambuza: "Uzoyithatha kanjani yonke le mpahla?"

UBheki uyaphendula: "Impahla ilula. Ngizoyithatha ngezandla zami." UBheki uthatha impahla kalula, bese uhamba ekhaya.

Ekhaya indodana yakhe iyambuza: "Uthenge kubani?"

UBheki uyaphendula: "Ngithenge kuNomvula. Ukuthenga kuye kulula, futhi impahla yakhe inhle."

Imibuzo:
UBheki ufuna ukuthengani?
Ufuna ukuthenga ukudla.
Ngubani igama lowesifazane?
Igama lakhe nguNomvula.
UBheki uthenga ishumi lezinto na?
Kunjalo, izinto zakhe ziyishumi.
Imali kaBheki iyalingana na?
Kunjalo, iyalingana.
UBheki uthatha impahla kanjani?
Uyithatha ngezandla zakhe, ngoba ilula.

lessons.title: UNjabulo esitolo
lessons.summary: Phumzile takes her small son Njabulo to the shop; he touches the things on the high shelves and cries, so she shops quickly and they go home.
lessons.text:
UPhumzile uya esitolo nomntwana wakhe, uNjabulo. UNjabulo ungumntwana omncane. Unamehlo amakhulu, futhi ubuka zonke izinto.

UPhumzile uvula umnyango. UNjabulo ungena emuva kwakhe. Lapho kunezinto eziningi. Ezinye izinto zikhona phansi, ezinye zikhona phezulu.

UNjabulo ubuka izinto ezibekwe phezulu. Iso lakhe libona into encane enhle. UNjabulo uyayithinta.

UPhumzile uthi: "Njabulo, ungathinti izinto ezibekwe phezulu! Kuyingozi. Lezi zinto ziyingozi ezinganeni ezincane."

Kodwa uNjabulo uthinta enye into futhi. UPhumzile uthatha isandla sakhe. UNjabulo uyakhala. Uthi: "Ngifuna into ekhona phezulu!"

UPhumzile uyashesha. Uthenga ukudla ngokushesha, bese uyakhokha. Uthi: "Njabulo, siyahamba manje."

Kodwa uNjabulo uhlala emuva. Uyakhala futhi. UPhumzile ubuya kuye. Uthi: "Ungakhali, mntwana wami. Ekhaya kunokudla okuhle."

UNjabulo uthatha isandla sikaPhumzile. Bayaphuma. UPhumzile uvala umnyango. Bahamba ekhaya ngokushesha.

Ekhaya uPhumzile uvula umnyango wendlu. Ubeka ukudla phezulu, ukuze uNjabulo angakuthinti. UNjabulo ubuka ukudla ngamehlo akhe amakhulu. Uthi: "Ukudla kuphezulu kakhulu!"

Imibuzo:
UNjabulo ungumntwana omncane na?
Kunjalo, ungumntwana omncane.
UNjabulo uthinta into ekhona phezulu na?
Kunjalo, uyayithinta.
UPhumzile uyashesha na?
Kunjalo, uyashesha.
UPhumzile uvala umnyango na?
Kunjalo, uyawuvala.

lessons.title: Umsebenzi wasebusuku
lessons.summary: Sifiso makes bread with a big machine at night; he waits and listens until the bread is ready, finishes at dawn and goes home to sleep.
lessons.text:
USifiso wenza isinkwa. Usebenza ebusuku, ngoba abantu bafuna isinkwa esisha uma kusile.

Ilanga liyashona. USifiso uya emsebenzini. Uvula umnyango, bese uyangena. Lapho kunomshini omkhulu. USifiso ufaka ukudla emshinini. Umshini usebenza ubusuku bonke.

USifiso ulinda isikhathi eside. Ulalela umshini. Uyezwa ukuthi umshini usebenza kahle.

Ngemuva kwesikhathi uSifiso ubheka emshinini. Ukudla akulungile. Uthi: "Kumele ngilinde futhi."

USifiso ulinda futhi. Ulalela umshini futhi. Manje uzwa ukuthi umshini uqedile umsebenzi wawo.

USifiso ukhipha isinkwa emshinini. Manje silungile, futhi sihle kakhulu. USifiso uqeda umsebenzi wakhe. Ubeka isinkwa phezulu, ukuze abantu basibone.

Kusile. Abantu bayeza. Bathenga isinkwa sikaSifiso.

USifiso uthi: "Ngilinde isikhathi eside, kodwa umsebenzi wami uqedile. Manje ngizolala." Uhamba ekhaya. Ulala usuku lonke. Uma ilanga lishona, uya emsebenzini futhi.

Imibuzo:
USifiso usebenza ebusuku na?
Kunjalo, usebenza ebusuku.
USifiso ulalela umshini na?
Kunjalo, uyawulalela.
Ukudla kulungile ekuqaleni na?
Cha, akulungile. USifiso kumele alinde.
USifiso wenzani uma kusile?
Uhamba ekhaya, bese uyalala.

lessons.title: Imboni entsha
lessons.summary: A food factory is built in Hlengiwe's town of Empangeni; it gives food and work, mostly to young people, and Hlengiwe asks the official about nature.
lessons.text:
UHlengiwe uhlala eMpangeni. Idolobha leli likhona esifundazweni saKwaZulu-Natal. Idolobha lihle, kodwa alinayo imboni enkulu. Abantu abaningi abanawo umsebenzi, ikakhulukazi intsha.

Ngolunye usuku isikhulu sesifundazwe siza edolobheni. Sikhuluma nabantu. Sithi: "Kuzokwakhiwa imboni enkulu lapha. Le mboni izokhiqiza ukudla."

Imboni yakhiwa unyaka wonke. UHlengiwe ubheka umsebenzi wokwakha njalo. Uthi: "Imboni inkulu kakhulu!"

Ngemuva konyaka imboni yakhiwe. Isikhulu siza edolobheni futhi. Sithi: "Imboni izohlinzeka idolobha ngokudla. Izohlinzeka nabantu ngomsebenzi."

Imboni iqala umsebenzi wayo. Iningi labantu abasebenza lapho liyintsha. Intsha ithola umsebenzi, ikakhulukazi intsha yaseMpangeni. NoHlengiwe uthola umsebenzi embonini.

Umphumela walokhu muhle. Abantu banemali, futhi idolobha linokudla okuningi. Iningi labantu lithi imboni inhle.

Kodwa uHlengiwe ucabanga ngemvelo. Ubuza isikhulu: "Imboni izoyigcina imvelo yethu na?"

Isikhulu siyaphendula: "Kunjalo. Imvelo yethu inhle. Imboni kumele igcine imvelo. Lokhu kuyingxenye yomsebenzi wayo."

UHlengiwe uthi: "Kuhle. Umphumela wemboni muhle kubantu nasemvelweni."

Imibuzo:
Idolobha linemboni enkulu ekuqaleni na?
Cha, alinayo imboni enkulu.
Imboni izohlinzeka idolobha ngokudla na?
Kunjalo, izolihlinzeka ngokudla.
Iningi labantu abasebenza embonini liyintsha na?
Kunjalo, iningi liyintsha.
UHlengiwe ucabanga ngemvelo na?
Kunjalo, ubuza isikhulu ngemvelo.

lessons.title: Umhlangano weqembu
lessons.summary: Mxolisi's group of food sellers in Durban needs a new place; at a meeting Thembeka gives her idea, all agree, and the government allows it.
lessons.text:
UMxolisi uhola iqembu labantu abathengisa ukudla eThekwini. Iqembu lidinga indawo entsha, ngoba indawo yalo indala futhi incane.

UMxolisi uxhumana nabo bonke abantu beqembu. Uthi: "Sizohlangana ngesonto elizayo. Sizoba nomhlangano."

Ngesonto elizayo abantu beqembu bayahlangana. Umhlangano uyaqala. UMxolisi uthi: "Inhloso yalo mhlangano yisinqumo mayelana nendawo yethu entsha."

UThembeka uthi: "Ngicela ukukhuluma. Nginombono mayelana nendawo."

UMxolisi uthi: "Kulungile. Wonke umuntu unelungelo lokukhuluma kulo mhlangano."

UThembeka uthi: "Umbono wami uthi: sizocela uhulumeni indawo enkulu phakathi kwedolobha."

Abantu bonke bayavuma. Bathi: "Siyavuma! Umbono wakho muhle."

Iqembu lithatha isinqumo. Isinqumo sithi iqembu lizocela uhulumeni indawo phakathi kwedolobha.

UMxolisi uxhumana nohulumeni. Utshela uhulumeni isinqumo seqembu. Uhulumeni uyavuma. Uthi: "Siyanivumela. Ninelungelo lokusebenzisa le ndawo."

Ngemuva kwesonto iqembu liyahlangana futhi. UMxolisi uthi: "Uhulumeni usivumele. Sinendawo entsha manje. Isinqumo sethu sihle."

Imibuzo:
Iqembu lidinga indawo entsha na?
Kunjalo, lidinga indawo entsha.
Inhloso yomhlangano iyini?
Yisinqumo mayelana nendawo entsha.
UThembeka unombono na?
Kunjalo, unombono mayelana nendawo.
Uhulumeni uyalivumela iqembu na?
Kunjalo, uyalivumela.

lessons.title: Amanzi amabi
lessons.summary: Sthembiso, a government health inspector, finds that bad water is causing a disease in Umlazi; people believe him in the end, use clean water and are safe.
lessons.text:
USthembiso usebenza kuhulumeni. Uhlola impilo yabantu.

Ngolunye usuku uSthembiso uthola umbiko. Umbiko uthi abantu abaningi baseMlazi banesifo. Abantu abathathu bafile.

USthembiso uya eMlazi. Uhlola ukudla namanzi abantu. Uthola iqiniso: amanzi mabi. Amanzi abanga isifo.

USthembiso ubika kubantu. Uthi: "Amanzi enu ayingozi. Abanga isifo. Lokhu kuyiqiniso."

Abanye abantu abakholwa. Bathi: "Asikholwa! Sisebenzisa amanzi lawa njalo."

USthembiso uthi: "Ngiyazi ukuthi lokhu kunzima. Kodwa iqiniso lithi abantu abathathu bafile ngenxa yalesi sifo. Kumele nivikele izingane zenu."

Ngosuku olulandelayo uhulumeni uletha amanzi amahle. USthembiso uthi: "Uhulumeni uzoletha amanzi amahle nsuku zonke. Sebenzisani amanzi lawa kuphela."

Manje abantu bayakholwa. Basebenzisa amanzi kahulumeni kuphela. Bavikela izingane zabo. Ngemuva kwesonto isifo siyaphela. Akekho umuntu ofayo manje. Abantu baphephile.

USthembiso ubhala umbiko omusha. Ubika ukuthi abantu baseMlazi baphephile manje. Uthi: "Isikhathi esinzima siphelile."

Imibuzo:
USthembiso uthola umbiko na?
Kunjalo, uthola umbiko mayelana nesifo.
Amanzi abanga isifo na?
Kunjalo, amanzi mabi. Abanga isifo.
Bonke abantu bayakholwa ekuqaleni na?
Cha, abanye abakholwa.
Uhulumeni uletha amanzi amahle na?
Kunjalo, uwaletha nsuku zonke.
Abantu baphephile manje na?
Kunjalo, baphephile.

lessons.title: Isifundo sokwenza ukudla
lessons.summary: Lerato teaches a cooking class to three young men and three young women in Pretoria; they struggle on the first day and get it right in the second lesson.
lessons.text:
ULerato ufundisa isifundo sokwenza ukudla ePitoli. Abafundi bakhe bayintsha: abesilisa abathathu nabesifazane abathathu. Bonke bafuna imfundo yokwenza ukudla okuhle.

Ngosuku lokuqala uLerato unika abafundi umbhalo. Umbhalo uchaza indlela yokulungisa ukudla. ULerato uthi: "Fundani umbhalo lo. Bese ngizonikhombisa."

ULerato ubakhombisa indlela. Uthatha ukudla, uyakulungisa kahle. Uthi: "Niyabona? Manje zamani nina."

Abafundi bayazama. Abesilisa bazama kakhulu, kodwa ukudla kwabo akulungile kahle. Abesifazane bazama futhi, kodwa nabo abawuqondi umbhalo kahle.

ULerato uthi: "Kulungile. Imfundo ithatha isikhathi. Nizozama futhi esifundweni sesibili."

Ngosuku lwesibili abafundi bafunda umbhalo futhi. ULerato uyabafundisa futhi, futhi ubakhombisa indlela kancane. Abesilisa nabesifazane bayazama. Manje bonke balungisa ukudla okuhle.

ULerato uthi: "Isifundo sesibili sihle kakhulu! Imfundo yenu iyaqhubeka. Ngizonifundisa futhi ngesonto elizayo."

Imibuzo:
ULerato ufundisani?
Ufundisa isifundo sokwenza ukudla.
Abafundi bakhe ngabesilisa nabesifazane na?
Kunjalo, ngabesilisa abathathu nabesifazane abathathu.
ULerato ukhombisa abafundi indlela na?
Kunjalo, ubakhombisa indlela yokulungisa ukudla.
Abafundi balungisa ukudla okuhle esifundweni sesibili na?
Kunjalo, bonke balungisa ukudla okuhle.

lessons.title: Isiko lomndeni
lessons.summary: Khwezi visits her grandmother Gugu's homestead for a family custom; a goat is killed, Gugu tells of the old war, and they share the food.
lessons.text:
UGugu ungumuntu omdala kakhulu. Uhlala emakhaya. Umuzi wakhe mkhulu. Kunezindlu eziningi kulo muzi. UKhwezi ungumntwana wendodana yakhe.

Ngolunye usuku umndeni wonke uza kulo muzi, ngisho nezingane ezincane. Kukhona isiko lomndeni.

Izulu lihle. UGugu ume ngaphambi kwendlu enkulu. UKhwezi ume naye.

Ngokwesiko, amadoda abulala imbuzi. UKhwezi uyabuza: "Gogo, lokhu kuyisiko na?"

UGugu uthi: "Kunjalo. Yisiko lethu. Sibulala imbuzi ukuze umndeni wonke udle kanye."

Bese uGugu utshela uKhwezi indaba yomuzi: "Kudala kakhulu amadoda alo muzi aya empini. Kwaba yimpi enkulu kakhulu. Abanye ababuyanga. Ngakho umndeni wethu uhlangana njalo kulo muzi."

Ngemuva kwalokho abesifazane balungisa ukudla. Umndeni wonke uyadla, ngisho nezingane. UGugu uthi: "Isiko lethu lithi ukudla kungokwabo bonke. Kuyisono uma umuntu edla yedwa."

UKhwezi uthatha ukudla, ukunika abantu abadala kuqala. UGugu uthi: "Khwezi, unenhliziyo enhle. Ngikuthanda ngenhliziyo yami yonke."

Usuku lonke izulu lihle. Ebusuku umndeni ulala kulo muzi. UKhwezi uthi: "Inhliziyo yami ithi ngizobuya njalo kulo muzi."

Imibuzo:
Umuzi kaGugu mkhulu na?
Kunjalo, umuzi wakhe mkhulu.
Izulu lihle na?
Kunjalo, izulu lihle usuku lonke.
Amadoda abulala imbuzi ngokwesiko na?
Kunjalo, abulala imbuzi ngoba yisiko.
Kuyisono uma umuntu edla yedwa na?
Kunjalo, isiko lithi kuyisono.

lessons.title: Isikhundla esisha
lessons.summary: Zukile is chosen to run the big food shop where he works; he opens earlier, welcomes people at the door and puts the food low so everyone can reach it.
lessons.text:
UZukile usebenza esitolo esikhulu sokudla eThekwini. Usebenza lapho iminyaka emithathu.

Ngolunye usuku abaholi bayahlangana. Baqoka uZukile. Bamnika isikhundla esisha: uzohola isitolo sonke.

UZukile ushiya umsebenzi wakhe omdala. Uthatha isikhundla sakhe esisha. Uthi: "Ngizoshintsha izinto ezithile."

Lapho abantu bavame ukulinda ngaphandle isikhathi eside, ngoba abasebenzi bavula umnyango kamuva. UZukile uyashintsha lokhu. Manje abasebenzi bavula umnyango uma kusile.

UZukile ume emnyango njalo. Uyabamukela abantu. Uthi: "Siyanamukela!"

Lapho ukudla okuningi kuphezulu kakhulu. Abantu abadala nezingane abakufinyeleli. Kunzima kubo. UZukile ushintsha lokhu futhi. Ubeka ukudla phansi, ukuze bonke bakufinyelele kalula.

Abantu bathi: "Manje sifinyelela ukudla kalula. Konke kushintshile."

Ngemuva kwenyanga abaholi bathi: "Siqoke kahle. UZukile ungumuntu ofanele lesi sikhundla." UZukile uvame ukuthi: "Isitolo sihle uma sibamukela abantu kahle."

Imibuzo:
Abaholi baqoka uZukile na?
Kunjalo, bamqoka. Bamnika isikhundla esisha.
UZukile ushiya umsebenzi wakhe omdala na?
Kunjalo, uyawushiya.
Abantu bavame ukulinda ngaphandle na?
Kunjalo, bavame ukulinda isikhathi eside.
Abantu bafinyelela ukudla kalula manje na?
Kunjalo, bakufinyelela kalula.

lessons.title: Isithombe sikaBusi
lessons.summary: Busi suspects someone is taking food from her small shop in Soweto; a photo shows the man, she finds him, and he works for a week to pay.
lessons.text:
UBusi unesitolo esincane eSoweto. Ngolunye usuku ubheka ukudla kwakhe. Ukudla okuningi akukho. UBusi uyasola. Usola ukuthi umuntu othile uthatha ukudla, kodwa akakhokhi.

Esitolo sikaBusi kunomshini wezithombe. UBusi ubuka izithombe zawo. Esithombeni esisodwa ubona indoda. Indoda ithatha ukudla, bese iyaphuma. Ayikhokhi.

UBusi ukhombisa isithombe leso abantu abeza esitolo. Uyababuza: "Niyayazi le ndoda?"

Abantu ababili bathi: "Kunjalo, siyayazi. Ihlala kuleyo ndlu encane." Bakhombisa indlu.

UBusi uthi: "Kuhle. Laba bantu bangisizile kakhulu."

UBusi uya kuleyo ndlu. Indoda ivula umnyango. UBusi uyikhombisa isithombe leso. Uthi: "Lo nguwe na? Wenze ngani lesi senzo?"

Indoda ithi: "Kunjalo, yimina. Angisebenzi, futhi umndeni wami awunakho ukudla."

UBusi uthi: "Lesi senzo sibi. Kodwa ngiyaqonda. Uzosebenza esitolo sami isonto lonke, ukuze ukhokhe ukudla."

Indoda iyavuma. Isebenza esitolo isonto lonke. Ikhokha konke. Laba bantu ababili bayayibona indoda isebenza.

UBusi uthi: "Wenze kahle. Qhubeka kanjalo."

Indoda ithi: "Ngizoqhubeka kanjalo. Ngeke ngenze leso senzo futhi."

Imibuzo:
UBusi uyasola na?
Kunjalo, usola ukuthi umuntu othile uthatha ukudla.
UBusi ubona indoda esithombeni na?
Kunjalo, ubona indoda ithatha ukudla.
Indoda yenze lesi senzo ngani?
Yenze kanjalo ngoba umndeni wayo awunakho ukudla.
Indoda iyakhokha na?
Kunjalo, isebenza esitolo, ikhokha konke.
